assertions.title: Config changes propagate to init and up

steps.action: Set `litellm-port` to 5050 and regenerate stack (`init --accept-defaults --force`), then start `up --tier longctx`
steps.observed: Config get returned 5050; `up` summary showed litellm healthy on 5050; endpoint advertised as `http://localhost:5050/v1`

steps.action: Call proxy endpoints on 5050 and 4000 with curl
steps.expected: 5050 responds successfully; 4000 is not the active proxy port
steps.observed: GET `http://127.0.0.1:5050/v1/models` returned HTTP 200 JSON; port 4000 connection failed
Config get returned 60; both recommend and init outputs showed `Budget: 76.8 GB` on 128 GB hardware

steps.action: Set `default-quant` to int8 and run `pull` without `--quant`
steps.expected: Pull resolves to int8 by default
steps.observed: Pull output used `Quantization: int8`; a second pull confirmed `DeepSeek R1 8B (int8)` already exists in configured model-dir

steps.action: Set `model-dir` to custom path and run `pull`/`models`
steps.expected: Pull destination and models listing use custom path
steps.observed: Config get returned custom path; pull destination pointed to custom path; models output reported `Models directory: .../custom-models`

evidence.network: curl GET http://127.0.0.1:5050/v1/models -> HTTP 200; curl GET http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1/models -> connection failed
evidence.ports: lsof showed listener on 127.0.0.1:5050 while stack was up; no listeners on 5050/4000 after down

frictions.description: Fresh pull attempts for `qwen3.5-0.8b` failed with `huggingface-cli not found` under strict-safe constraints (no installs/wrappers).
frictions.resolution: Used existing local int8 model (`deepseek-r1-8b`) to validate default-quant and custom model-dir propagation through successful pull resolution and models output.

summary: VAL-CROSS-007 retest in strict-safe mode passed: litellm-port 5050 propagated through config/init/up with live endpoint success on 5050, memory-budget 60 propagated to recommend/init, and default-quant/model-dir settings propagated to pull/models behavior.
